title: The corgi who left the race (Scribe; blocky-avatar game look)

voice.name: Slax (generic Fish library voice; user rule Nov 9: male narrators only)

beats.say: This corgi had one fucking job. Run in a straight line.
Sunday, NFL halftime. The corgi race. The other dogs run for the finish. Quinn? Absolutely fucking not.
Quinn takes the whole field. The forty! The forty-five! Midfield!
The handlers dive. Miss. Dive again. Miss again.
The second half? Delayed. By a fucking corgi.
They finally grab her near the forty. Ollie wins the race. Quinn wins the whole fucking internet.
Even the team posted: still a good boy, though.
Meanwhile, you: twenty fucking genetics problems. Handwritten. Due at midnight.
So pull a Quinn. Snap one photo. Scribe solves all twenty, in your own fucking handwriting. Punnett squares too.
Your teacher dives for a mistake. Misses. Still a good student, though.
